title: Erich W. Kopischke
vital_facts: Baptized as a child; Aaronic Priesthood as a youth; Melchizedek Priesthood as a young adult
Missionary to the Germany Munich Mission, 1975-77
Married Christiane Gluck, 18 December 1978; Bern Switzerland Temple; seven children
Employment: Insurance industry; Church Educational System
Counselor in Bishopric, Branch President, Stake High Councilor, District President, Stake President, Area Seventy, and Counselor in the Europe Central Area
